name: Adjustable Open Patella Knee Support Brace | Compression Knee Cap for Gym, Running, Walking & Sports | Joint Support for Men & Women | Random Color
description:
Support your knees during workouts and everyday activities with this Adjustable Open Patella Knee Support Brace. Designed with an open-patella structure and adjustable straps, it provides a secure and customizable fit while allowing comfortable movement. Made from soft, flexible neoprene-infused material, this knee support is suitable for activities such as gym workouts, running, walking, basketball, squats, and other physical activities. The adjustable design allows it to be worn on either the left or right knee, making it a practical choice for everyday knee support.

How to Use
Place the knee brace around the knee with the patella positioned in the open section
Wrap and secure the adjustable straps around the knee
Adjust the straps until the brace feels comfortably secure
Ensure the brace does not feel excessively tight
Re-adjust the straps whenever necessary during use

Material / Composition
Neoprene-Infused Fabric
Elastic Support Material
Adjustable Straps

Safety Information
Do not wear the brace excessively tight
Stop use if you experience significant pain, numbness, swelling, or skin irritation
Do not use on broken or severely irritated skin
Keep the brace clean and dry
This product is intended as a supportive accessory and is not a replacement for professional medical treatment
Consult a healthcare professional for serious or persistent knee problems
